notes.title: For Every Negative, There's A Positive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/89e7f08e1500104232859338258d118e511d6115.png[/img]

I wish it wasn't so, but I had to shut down the live servers for Synthwave Racers due to a lack of funds. Not enough people played the game to warrant the expensive price tag for full blown game servers. I really thank everyone who purchased the game and enjoyed the realtime online functionality!

But the good news is that I have migrated the server as a downloadable file from the company website, for free! So you can still play with your friends. The process is akin to setting up a Minecraft server. As a thank you for dealing with the unfortunate circumstances, I have also released the brand-new Battle Mode, available to play by setting up the server!

You can access the server by joining the Discord at https://discord.gg/DmHHXNTAnn - and head over to the ~game-servers channel!

Sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you all!

- Corrtex

notes.title: Grand Prix + Splitscreen Mode Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Racers,[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/edjtoPd.png[/img]

[i]The Grand Prix / Splitscreen Update is finally here![/i]

Along with 2 new achievements! ^(._.)^

For every piece of good news, there is also some not-as-great news, though:

[i]Unfortunately, live servers will also be getting shut down relatively soon[/i] due to lack of playerbase, as they are very expensive - I will hopefully be rolling out the server to be downloadable and configurable yourself, so you can still have your friends play online with you - just not against strangers around the world.

Cheers, and enjoy the local multiplayer!

notes.title: V 1.1.0 - Minor Patch A
notes.content:
[h2][i]Greetings, Racers![/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/ab4e714263f61dce6f8261eefa12846f6152739d.png[/img]

[h3]The first minor patch for Synthwave Racers is here![/h3]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dying on the curvy part of Freezy Peak would result in a respawn with incorrect initial player gravity
[*] Fixed an issue where using the jump powerup and gliding into your next surface, as opposed to landing from above it, would prevent the powerup from activating again
[*] Fixed up the middle tunnel in Ragdoll City so that when you manage to enter it, you can't get stuck to the side of one of the boosts without activating it
[*] Stuttering that was occurring for some players upon finishing Campaign courses should be alleviated now
[/list]

Quality of Life Improvements
[list]
[*] When finding and collecting a [i][b]Secret Hidden Item[/b][/i], a UI element will now appear showing you what the item is, and whether you have unlocked it already or not

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/3e39c9448ef59cccb2ceb0d26b74bae14adf041d.png[/img]
[*] Xbox controller rumble is now toggle-able (Playstation rumble still isn't supported yet)
[*] Target FPS is now controllable between [i]30[/i], [i]60[/i], [i]90[/i], [i]120[/i], [i]144[/i], and [i]240[/i]
[*] A full course-selection screen has now replaced the "Race Course Again?" dialogue when completing Ghost Trials courses, whether online or offline. If playing online, and you choose a course where there isn't currently an online record, it will simply place you into offline mode - but it will remember your desired mode is online still for future course selections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/7da9f2f219fb35b9c21cb96b932490b0bbb3ecbb.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2][i]Remember![/i]
[/h2]
Don't forget to Join the Discord so you can report more bugs like these, request features to be implemented, and even get access to the global high scores for certain game modes! We have a small but passionate community that is itching to get more racers on board!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/DmHHXNTAnn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/5656cecaad0df9218269db431a27dfb8b089bfe3.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Happy racing![/h3]

- Corrtex

notes.title: V 1.0.1 - Micro Patch A
notes.content:
[i][h2]Greetings, Racers![/h2][/i]

[b]A few small release-day changes, coming in [i]HOT![/i][/b]

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where rotating obstacle speeds were affected by player framerate
[/list]
[u]Quality of Life Improvements[/u]
[list]
[*] Xbox and Playstation controllers can now use the D-Pad/Arrow Pad to navigate the menus
[*] Client configuration(.cfg) files are now stored in the persistent data path instead of the game installation file, so future updates will no longer overwrite your settings preferences ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

Don't forget to Join the Discord so you can report bugs, request features, and even get access to the global high scores for certain game modes!

[url=https://discord.gg/DmHHXNTAnn][img]https://i.imgur.com/TXDdWZj.png[/img][/url]

[b][i]Happy racing![/i][/b]

- Corrtex

notes.title: The Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Riders![/h1]

[h2]In preparation for Steam Next Fest, the demo build has been updated with a plethora of fixes, graphics updates, and even new gameplay features![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/cf2f370f9b81b3b0327481a215741d63d9f932d9.png[/img]

[h2]Notable Gameplay Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gear shifts now occur when increasing or decreasing speed. There is min gear, middle gear, and max gear
[*] Once you reach mid gear, you will now explode if you run straight on into a wall! 
[*] A new announcer voice that sounds more cyberpunky is now in the game, and has voice lines for multiple different events (such as dying, flips, countdown, goal, finish, gear shifting, and more!)
[*] A ragdoll of your character will now spawn on death
[*] Ragdolls fly around for a bit and interact with the level. You can even finish campaign levels with your dead body!
[*] Ragdoll City Minigame - replacing the Sandbox is Ragdoll City, the adrenaline-crazed town where you compete to see how far you can send your body flying! Shoot through boost zones, get flung around by hammers, and more, to try and reach the highest score possible.
[*] Added a second Ghost Trials course to the demo - Downtown Drive!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/47cc0366b22c3223777a56c1b3ae5b0c4eff07a8.png[/img]

[h2]Notable Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Falling through the floor no longer occurs
[*] Improved stuttering on certain road paths
[*] Fixed some issues with the Settings UI
[/list]

[h2]Notable Quality of Life Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] In-Game HUD has been redone in a more pleasant and aesthetic manner
[*] Added more gameplay options, including a few settings to help reduce computing resources for those running on less powerful computers
[*] Mouse hides itself when using a controller
[*] Button graphics will now change to show the current input preference
[*] Playstation dualshock/dualsense controller support
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/1a26684c98631493a21b752956fde5470fef6ff1.png[/img]

Graphics Updates:
[list]
[*] Switched to linear color space instead of gamma
[*] Adjusted lighting on all levels
[*] Added color grading post processing
[*] Tinkered with post processing values for bloom, blur, SSR, and AO
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42010403/b844cdfbe14bf8f5c8697f796e5913ab414793ad.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the fest! [url=https://discord.gg/DmHHXNTAnn]Join the Discord[/url] to request new features, report bugs, or chat with like minded Synthwave Racers!
